scope: 提取任务列表正文，保留原任务标题与指令；不使用旧索引重新编号，不将任务设计当作实测通过。

definitions.SG: 理解物体描述，区分相似实例，并定位到指令所指的目标。
definitions.SP: 理解楼层和空间关系，在往返过程中维持对位置与房间的记忆。
definitions.GE: 跨室内外场景导航，研究环境、光照、视野与相机高度的变化。
definitions.LH: 执行有前后依赖的多阶段任务，跟踪进度、拆解任务并保留长程记忆。
definitions.MP: 在狭窄通道、密集障碍与动态行人之间安全移动，完成精确停靠。
definitions.SE: 在指定时间预算内完成路线，兼顾到点、停留和行进效率。

context: 环境线索：文字描述、静态地图与动态定位地图。
先验知识：商超摆放、医院布局、工厂流程等。

tasks.title: Bistro 街区中的四站精确导航
tasks.sceneHeading: 场景一｜Bistro 街区（训练集）
tasks.instruction: 你在咖啡馆卵石街道的北端。沿街一路向南走：先经过写有 MENU 的黑板停一秒，再走到街角的蓝色小摩托车旁停一秒，最后走到露台前的白色花盆旁，面对花盆停稳1秒。路上注意避让行人：等行人走过后再穿过他们的路线。时间预算100秒。
tasks.formalEnglish: Start at the north end of the cobblestone cafe street. Walk south along the street: first stop for one second at the chalkboard sign that says MENU, then stop for one second beside the blue scooter at the corner, and finally walk to the white planter in front of the terrace and stand still facing it for one second. Give way to pedestrians: wait for them to pass before you cross their path. Time budget is 100 seconds.

tasks.title: Emerald 城市公园中的四站精确导航
tasks.sceneHeading: 场景二｜Emerald 城市公园（训练集）
tasks.instruction: 你在城市公园的人行道旁。先走到绿色公交车前停一秒，再走到入口处的波浪形自行车架旁停一秒，最后走进公园到大橡树下，面对橡树停稳1秒。路上注意避让行人：等行人走过后再穿过他们的路线。时间预算150秒。
tasks.formalEnglish: Start on the sidewalk by the city park. Walk to the green bus and stop for one second. Then walk to the wavy bike racks near the entrance and stop for one second. Finally walk into the park to the large oak tree and stop facing it for one second. Give way to pedestrians: wait for them to pass before you cross their path. Time budget is 150 seconds.
tasks.versionNote: 任务章节原标训练集；当前 3+1 场景配置将 Emerald 划为测试集。

tasks.title: 沙丘定向越野：常规预算
tasks.sceneHeading: 场景二｜沙漠越野（训练集）
tasks.instruction: 你从高沙丘顶的白环出发，先原地环视 360° 确认三面编号旗位置：向东南跑红色1号旗，再向北跑黄色2号旗，右转向西南跑蓝色3号旗，最后向东返回白环；每面旗旁停留1秒；时间预算130秒。
tasks.formalEnglish: You start at a white ring on top of a tall sand dune, with three numbered flags in view. First turn around 360 degrees in place to locate the three numbered flags; then run to the red flag 1 to the southeast; from flag 1 run north to the yellow flag 2; at flag 2 turn right and run southwest to the blue flag 3; finally run back east to the white ring where you started. Dwell for one second beside each flag. Your time budget is 130 seconds.

tasks.title: 同场同路线定向越野：更紧预算

tasks.instruction: 你从高沙丘顶的白环出发，先原地环视 360° 确认三面编号旗位置：向东南跑红色1号旗，再向北跑黄色2号旗，右转向西南跑蓝色3号旗，最后向东返回白环；每面旗旁停留1秒；尽快完成；时间预算80秒。
tasks.formalEnglish: You start at a white ring on top of a tall sand dune, with three numbered flags in view. First turn around 360 degrees in place to locate the three numbered flags; then run to the red flag 1 to the southeast; from flag 1 run north to the yellow flag 2; at flag 2 turn right and run southwest to the blue flag 3; finally run back east to the white ring where you started. Dwell for one second beside each flag. Finish as fast as you can. Your time budget is 80 seconds.

tasks.title: Infinigen 草甸直线往返（测试任务）
tasks.sceneHeading: 场景四｜Infinigen 程序化草甸（测试集）
tasks.instruction: 你站在开阔草甸缓丘间的白环上。沿草地直奔立杆上的橙旗，到达后直线返回白环；旗前与回环各停 1 秒；时间预算 180 秒。
tasks.formalEnglish: You are standing on a white ring in an open grassy meadow with rolling hills. Run straight across the meadow to the tall orange flag on the post, then run straight back to the white ring where you started. Stop for one second at the flag and again when you are back at the ring. Your time budget is 180 seconds.
